evidence.summary: Learning objective and scope: Introduces `pygame.mixer`, separates `mixer.Sound` (short effects, fully loaded) from `mixer.music` (streamed background track), and warns against loading assets inside the loop.

`pygame.mixer.Sound` and `pygame.mixer.music` are distinct tools: many simultaneous short sounds on channels vs one streamed music track. -- Confirmed -- both APIs exist and behave as described under pygame-ce 2.5.8 with SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy.

`pygame.mixer.music.play(loops=-1)` loops indefinitely. -- Confirmed -- the C signature is play(loops=0, start=0.0, fade_ms=0), so `loops` is a valid keyword; calling music.load(...) then music.play(loops=-1) succeeded.

`pygame.mixer.init()` is normally covered by `pygame.init()` but can be called explicitly. -- Confirmed -- without any init, mixer.Sound(...) raises `pygame.error: mixer not initialized`; an explicit mixer.init() fixes it.

Constructing `Sound(...)` reads from disk, so it must happen once before the loop. -- Confirmed -- notebook 20-24 measures five play() calls on a preloaded Sound at 0.0001 s total, versus a fresh construction per call which re-reads the file.
